how_to_fill: Fill empty "khmer" fields. Do not rename keys or change "english".
Keep placeholders {{likeThis}} and {0} unchanged inside Khmer text.
Keep HTML tags (e.g. <sub>...</sub>) if present; translate surrounding text only.
PRIORITY 1 — sim_visible_ui: title, fit/order radios, checkboxes, Deviations/Equation panels, chi-squared info dialog, patterns/symbols.
PRIORITY 2 — shared_joist_chrome / shared_scenery_phet_chrome: PhET menu, About/Credits, Preferences (Settings), Reset All, Keyboard Shortcuts.
This sim is SINGLE-SCREEN (no separate practice/game pages). All main UI is on the Curve Fitting screen; Settings/Preferences open from the PhET menu.
Math symbols (a,b,c,d,x,y,r,X,N,f) can stay Latin if preferred — still listed so you can decide.
Backend/dev-only strings omitted (sun/tambo/twixt demo titles, credit person names).
No sim-specific a11y string file in this older sim; sun a11y Closed/Next/etc. omitted (screen-reader only).
Send this file back when ready; we will apply into babel as curve-fitting-strings_km.json (+ joist/scenery-phet as needed).
Applied into babel: curve-fitting-strings_km.json, joist-strings_km.json, scenery-phet-strings_km.json (chrome keys merged).
